baseline: Run each prompt once with the skill and once without it (same model), then compare: share of quotes that verify verbatim against a page, gaps with a full evidence trail (>=5 records, >=3 domains), whether coverage limits are stated, and whether any excluded source (G2, Capterra, Reddit .json, Upwork) was fetched.

evals.prompt: Find market gaps in invoicing and payment follow-up tools for freelance translators. I want something I could build as a small SaaS.
evals.expected_output: A completed run folder with a dossier ranking evidence-backed gaps, certainty labels, coverage limits and a handoff.json for validation.
expectations: The agent created a run with `gapscan.py init` and froze protocol.json before any search (protocol.lock.json exists).
landscape/saturation.json exists and the dossier reports its verdict as a lower bound (wording such as 'at least').
At least 95% of evidence records in evidence/ledger.jsonl have verification.status = verified.
Every EV id cited in output/dossier.md and output/handoff.json exists in the ledger and is verified (output/report-check.json ok = true).
Each ranked opportunity shows pain certainty, demand certainty and demand strength 'weak' exactly as in gaps/certainty.json.
No snapshot URL in cache/snapshot-index.jsonl belongs to an excluded domain (g2.com, capterra.com, reddit.com, upwork.com, indiehackers.com).
output/prisma.md exists and the dossier has coverage and limitations sections.

evals.prompt: I want to approve each step. Look for underserved needs in appointment scheduling software for small dental clinics in Europe, gated mode please.
evals.expected_output: A gated run that stops for human approval at the protocol, landscape and shortlist, recording approvals in human-tasks.json.
expectations: The agent stopped at a BLOCKED human task before freezing the protocol and did not freeze it until the task was marked done.
human-tasks.json contains judgment tasks with gates protocol#N, landscape#N and shortlist#N.
Human directives given in conversation were recorded with `gapscan.py protocol amend` (amendments in protocol.lock.json).

evals.prompt: Which opportunities are underserved in inventory and stock apps for small Shopify merchants? Give me ranked opportunities with the evidence.
evals.expected_output: Ranked opportunities from marketplace and community evidence with independent scouts, reliability-checked coding and a red team per gap.
expectations: landscape/units.json lists sampling units from at least 3 different channel families.
coding/agreement.json exists with per-code Krippendorff alpha and a verdict.
Every ranked gap has a gaps/redteam/GAP-NNN.json with at least 3 logged searches.
gaps/ranking.json reports p_top3 for every ranked gap.
The agent did not post, message, create accounts or log in anywhere.
